sub_scenario.family: communicating uncertainty and risk escalation in cross-functional decisions
sub_scenario.one_line: product incident liaison: accept the structured morning rotation

dialogue.content: I spent the first hour tidying the issue ledger and closing stale entries.
Anything still open?
Two items, both with owners.
The support rota review wrapped early today.
Any surprises in it?
None worth recording.
I posted a routine status note after last week's resolved login ticket.
Was the cause still disputed?
No, the fix was already recorded.
Someone new shadowed me in the product desk this morning.
Did that slow you down?
A little, but the questions were good ones.
I batched my replies about the launch weeks into one message before lunch.
Cleaner than drip-feeding answers.
Much cleaner.
I did a standard pass over the support rota records this morning.
Any exceptions in there?
None worth a note.
I routed three duplicate reports to the same closed thread on Tuesday.
Did that require a cross-team escalation?
No, I only matched them to an existing entry.
I archived last cycle's notes on the support rota and set up the new folder.
A fresh start?
As fresh as these things get.
The weekday office hour is scheduled for 10:00, and the shared evidence worksheet must be uploaded before each session.
Are those arrangements fixed?
Yes, both appear on the support rota.
A vendor call about the issue ledger ran long but ended well.
Worth the time?
This one, yes.
I walked through the product desk checklist with the new starter.
How did they do?
Careful and quick, a good sign.
Quiet afternoon; I cleared the backlog around the launch weeks.
A rare day.
I did not waste it.
I flagged a small inconsistency in the support rota records and fixed it at the source.
Root cause or symptom?
Root cause, for once.
I closed a routine launch weeks cycle without surprises.
Follow-up needed?
A note for the next cycle, nothing more.
I sketched next week's plan for the launch weeks before leaving.
Ahead of schedule?
Ahead enough to sleep well.
Lunch walk, then a clean pass through the issue ledger updates.
Does the walk help?
It resets the afternoon.
The worksheet template has separate columns for observations and hypotheses, and the rota permits a deferred follow-up slot the next morning.
Are both fields available?
Yes, the template and deferral slot are on the approved form.
I compared two options for the support rota tooling and noted a mild preference.
Decision made?
Deferred until the trial ends.
I closed the week by updating the product desk handover notes.
Anything unusual to hand over?
Blessedly little.
The support lead has offered me the weekday 10:00 escalation office hour with the shared worksheet. Is that a role I should take on?
